entries.cbff2117153a08b1: An industry that earns revenue by developing land and buildings and then leasing, selling or managing them. It includes companies that lease office buildings and commercial facilities, companies that sell condominiums and detached houses, and companies that buy existing properties, raise their value and resell them. There are also companies that build rental housing and lease it back from owners, and companies that handle brokerage and management.
